title: בפעם הראשונה מכת״י: פסקי דינים לכ״ק אדמו״ר האמצעי
Tes Kislev: Mitteler Rebbe’s Birthday and Yahrtzeit
blurb: As pressure mounted from the government and a devastating decree loomed, the Mitteler Rebbe ’s last journey led him to Haditch and then to Niezhin, where he recited his final maamorim and ascended on high.

title: Sixteen Years Later, I’m Still Learning That Same Sefer
blurb: A late-night Chassidus shiur in a Pittsburgh zal left a lasting impression on Yehuda Ringler , inspiring him years later to create a new online resource that makes learning the Mitteler Rebbe’s Shaar Hayichud easier and more accessible.

title: The Rebbe’s View: Should We Be Making Aliyah?
blurb: As the alarming rise in antisemitism continues to spread and grow increasingly outspoken, hundreds of thousands have begun turning toward moving to Eretz Yisroel. In spite of the ongoing public conversation and debate, it is worth revisiting the Rebbe’s view and clear guidance about making aliyah.

title: The Part of Learning Chassidus Nobody Can Do for You
blurb: Chassidus was never meant to stay on the page. But what does it actually look like when someone takes a ma’amar and makes it real, real to themselves, in their own words, in their own life? And why does that take so much courage?

title: The Rebbe’s Chinuch Tools for When a Child Says ‘I Can’t’
blurb: A new free webinar series will equip teachers with practical tools from the Rebbe’s 12 Pesukim, beginning with a special session on helping children overcome feelings of “I can’t” and develop confidence in their abilities.

title: Video: A Whole New Light: The Mitteler Rebbe’s Liberation Living Torah
blurb: When denser darkness is conquered, the resultant light that shines forth out of the darkness is ever the brighter.
